subject: microbiology
title: Peyer Patches, Enteric Fever Pathogenesis, Non-Typhoidal Salmonella and Ty21a

steps.tx: **Peyer patches** are typhoid's intestinal stage: ileal lymphoid follicles invaded via M cells, macrophages carry bacilli to liver, spleen and marrow (reticuloendothelial phase, first incubation), patches hyperplasia then ulcerate along the bowel's long axis in week three, bleeding and perforating where ulcers deepen.
steps.say: Ileal patches ulcerate lengthwise; week three bleeds and holes are patch geography.

left.title: Pathogenesis sequence
points: M cell entry to Peyer patches
Secondary bacteraemia seeds gallbladder and patches again

right.title: Patch pathology
points: Necrosis and oval ulcers long axis

steps.tx: **Wilson Blair** from the media module (bismuth sulfite black colonies) and **XLD agar** (xylose lysine deoxycholate: Salmonella red with black centres by H2S and lysine, Shigella red without) and DCA divide stool Salmonella work, selenite enrichment for carriers. Black centres in stool plates demand Salmonella serogrouping next.
steps.say: Red colony, black heart on XLD: Salmonella until serology speaks.

left.title: XLD logic
points: Xylose fermented then lysine decarboxylated (reversion red)
Shigella red no black (no H2S, no lysine use)

right.title: Confirmatory chain
points: TSI alkaline slant acid butt, gas, H2S (Typhi gasless weak H2S)
Reference serotyping Kauffmann White (O, H phase 1 and 2)

steps.tx: **Non typhoidal Salmonella** (Typhimurium, Enteritidis and thousands serovars, animal reservoirs eggs poultry reptiles) causes inflammatory gastroenteritis 6 to 72 hours after food, usually self limited without antibiotics (which prolong carriage), invasive in infants, elderly, HIV (recurrent bacteraemia Africa, iNTS lineages) and sickle cell osteomyelitis fame.
steps.say: Eggs and reptiles purge for two days; HIV and sickle cell invite Salmonella into blood and bone.

right.title: Invasive portrait
points: iNTS Africa: bacteraemia without diarrhoea often
Sickle osteomyelitis (Salmonella classic, staph commoner overall)
Treat bacteraemia by susceptibility, hunt aorta

steps.tx: **Ty21a** live oral vaccine (attenuated Typhi galE mutant) needs three to four alternate day enteric capsules, cold chain, no antibiotics concurrent, mucosal IgA and cellular protection about fifty to seventy percent, used travellers more than endemic programmes where TCV injectable conjugate won.
steps.say: Four capsules, no antibiotics, partial protection: Ty21a is traveller heritage now.

left.title: Ty21a rules
points: Live, refrigerated, swallowed whole with cool liquid
Doses alternate days completed before travel week

right.title: Vaccine league now
points: TCV conjugate: single dose from 6 months, endemic programmes
No Paratyphi A vaccine any platform

steps.tx: **Salmonella serotyping** (Kauffmann White: O somatic groups, H flagellar phases with phase inversion) names thousands of serovars for outbreak traceback now genome sequenced (serotype predicted in silico), eggs and farm chains convicted by cluster fingerprints shared across countries.
steps.say: O and H letters named serovars; genomes now type the outbreak before eggs are recalled.

left.title: Serotyping grammar
points: O groups A to Z and beyond numbered

steps.tx: **Gastroenteritis management** beside Salmonella: ORS central, antibiotics reserved (infants under months thresholds, immunocompromise, invasive, prosthetic vascular risk), antimotility caution, exclusion of food handlers until stools clear by local rule, reptile counselling for households with infants.
steps.say: Hydrate the many, antibiotic the vulnerable few, exclude the food handler.

left.title: Antibiotic indications
points: Sickle cell and vascular graft hosts

steps.tx: **Salmonella in bone and vessels**: osteomyelitis in sickle cell (infarcted bone seeded during bacteraemia, Salmonella emblem but Staphylococcus commoner), endarteritis of abdominal aortic aneurysms (mycotic) with prolonged therapy and surgery, prosthetic joint and psoas niches by bacteraemia seeding.
steps.say: Salmonella loves dead bone and diseased aorta; bacteraemia in those hosts is imaged, not just treated.

left.title: Bone disease
points: Culture from bone, not blood alone
Weeks of therapy and surgical drainage

right.title: Vascular disease
points: Aneurysm and graft infection elderly men

steps.tx: **Enteric fever surgery** closes patches lesson: perforation presents peritonitis after initial improvement deception, resuscitation, broad antibiotics plus metronidazole, simple closure or resection ileostomy by contamination, mortality set by delay, second perforations watched. Microbiology becomes abdominal emergency by week three.
steps.say: Sudden pain after quieter typhoid week two is perforation; resuscitate, cover, operate.

right.title: Surgical stack
points: Simple closure versus resection by state
